extraction: Parsed from the LaTeX source of the accepted manuscript arXiv:2603.26869 = A&A 709, A254. The four velocity-dispersion catalogues are each a SINGLE 'longtable' environment, not a pair of 'table*' environments, so the split-table truncation failure mode does not apply here. Rows were split on the LaTeX row terminator and cells on '&'; \textbf{} bolding (which marks the BCG) and LaTeX math/escape markup were stripped and '$-$' was converted to '-'. ROW-COUNT ASSERTION: the four tables parsed to 213 rows in total, exactly the '213 measured sigma values across the four clusters' stated in the paper abstract and in the CDS ReadMe for J/A+A/709/A254. Per-cluster parsed counts: A2744=76, AS1063=34, MACS0416=52, MACS1149=51.
note: Granata et al. 2026 A&A 709, A254, appendix velocity-dispersion catalogue for MACS J1149.6+2223. MEASURED: RA/Dec (J2000) and the line-of-sight STELLAR VELOCITY DISPERSION sigma of cluster member galaxies, from pPXF fits to VLT/MUSE integral-field spectra (spectral S/N >= 10, statistical uncertainty typically below 5 per cent), with its 1-sigma error and the spectral S/N. This is a genuine kinematic OBSERVABLE, not a lens-model output. MEMBERSHIP: every galaxy listed is a confirmed cluster member. This table is NOT in VizieR -- the VizieR catalogue J/A+A/709/A254 carries only the structural parameters. Join on the ID column to MACS1149_Granata2026_AA709_A254_members_structural.raw.tsv to attach effective radius, Sersic index, axis ratio and position angle. No stellar mass and no redshift in this table.
